_note: agenda-ai-paper-summaries (age-16, age-20, plt-27): an AI summary or comparison of a meeting paper is a record with a review status. The review states are a declarative lifecycle and who reads what is a declarative read rule: members read shown summaries only, the secretariat and administrators read all. Generating the text is imperative (PaperSummaryService and PaperSummaryTaskListener: an external AI provider, ADR-031 exception). Numbered 119, not the 92 the design names: 92 was taken by citizen advice on motions.

PaperSummary.title: Paper summary
PaperSummary.description: An AI-generated summary of a meeting paper, or of the main differences between two papers, that a clerk checks before members read it.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: The agenda item the paper is attached to.

paperFileId.title: Paper
paperFileId.description: The Nextcloud file id of the paper (schema:isBasedOn).

paperTitle.title: Paper title
paperTitle.description: The file name of the paper when the summary was asked for.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A summary of one paper, or a comparison of two.

comparedFileId.title: Compared with
comparedFileId.description: The Nextcloud file id of the second paper of a comparison.

comparedTitle.title: Compared with (title)
comparedTitle.description: The file name of the second paper of a comparison.

text.title: Text
text.description: The AI output in markdown, then the clerk's edit of it.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The TaskProcessing provider that wrote the text, for provenance.

taskId.title: Task
taskId.description: The TaskProcessing task that writes the text.

chunked.title: Summarised in parts
chunked.description: True when the paper was too long for one task and was summarised part by part.

status.title: Status
status.description: requested until the AI answers, then draft or failed; a clerk shows a draft to members or hides it.

failure.title: Failure
failure.description: The provider's error message when the task failed.

reviewedBy.title: Checked by
reviewedBy.description: The display name of the clerk who last showed or hid the summary, as the label shows it.

reviewedAt.title: Checked at
reviewedAt.description: When the clerk last showed or hid the summary.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative review states (ADR-031, REQ-APS-001). A failed summary is not retried in place: Try again asks for a new one.
